disabled.description:
Disabled count.
The count of disabled test cases or assertions for #cases and #assertions respectively.
Whether the test is ignored at the suite or case level, all cases or assertions are counted.

disabledByCause.description:
Map from ticket number to count of disabled cases (for #cases) or assertions (for #assertions) caused by the
ticket.
Sorted in descending order of count.

disabledByTestSuite.description:
Map from test suite name to count of disabled cases (for #cases) or assertions (for #assertions) in that test
suite.
Sorted in descending order of count.

title: Stats for a group of test suites based on granularity (test case or test assertion).
name: TestSuiteSummary.Stats
